summary: Build an Instagram-like social media app.
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Minimal modern wordmark logo on light background (app-logo.dim_512x512.png)
- Neutral default user avatar icon illustration (default-avatar.dim_256x256.png)
- Clean empty-state illustration (no posts yet) with abstract shapes (empty-feed.dim_1200x800.png)

existing_features.title: Implement Internet Identity authentication so users can sign in/out and the app can identify the current user principal.
Create a backend user profile model and APIs to create/read/update the current user's profile (display name, bio, avatar image) and to read other users' profiles.
Implement photo post creation with image upload, caption, timestamp, and author; store posts in the Motoko backend and display them in the frontend.
Build a home feed UI that lists posts (image, author, caption, time) and supports pagination or incremental loading.
Implement social interactions: like/unlike posts and add/delete comments (by comment author).
Implement following: users can follow/unfollow other users; profile pages show follower/following counts; feed can be filtered to show posts from followed accounts.
Add basic discovery UI: a simple user search (by display name) and navigation to user profiles.
Create a coherent visual theme for the app (colors, typography, layout) and apply it consistently across feed, profile, post composer, and search screens (do not use blue/purple as primary palette).
Generate and include required static images (logo, default avatar, and an empty-state illustration) and render them from frontend static assets.

new_feature_requests.summary: Create an Instagram-like app (photo/video feed with social interactions).
